style: Writing style: In Swedish she opens with "Hej <name>!" and signs off "Ha det fint, Ada". In English she opens with "Hi <name>," and signs off "Best, Ada". Short, warm sentences, getting to the point at once, and she thanks people often.
memories: Ada works as a designer at Studio Norr in Umeå.
Ada's daughter Elsa plays football on Saturdays.
